A lot of time is spent moving forward in this game and it can be tiring to hold the joystick up for long periods of time. 

To make it easier to play, in mode 1, Left Analog, holding the joystick up for two seconds will latch the up movement until either up or down is applied.

A beep will sound when the latch actives and the joystick can be centered up and down and the character will move forward.  Move the joystick left and right to steer.

Move the joystick slightly up or down to cancel the movement.

In mode 2, the forward movement is not latched.  Mode 2 works better for maneuvering in tight situations where forward movement is not sustained.
